title: JD(S) takes out bike rally in protest against milk price, bus fare hike

ai.summary: Janata Dal (Secular) activists held a motorcycle rally in Yadgir to protest state government hikes in milk, curd, and bus fares, citing drought impacts and affordability issues for farmers and households.

facts.claim: Several hundreds Janata Dal (Secular) activists and supporters of Gurmitkal MLA Sharanagouda Kandkur took out a motorcycle rally in Yadgir on Thursday to protest against the State government decision to hike the prices of milk, curd and also, bus fares.
facts.quote: Several hundreds Janata Dal (Secular) activists and supporters of Gurmitkal MLA Sharanagouda Kandkur took out a motorcycle rally in Yadgir on Thursday to protest against the State government decision to hike the prices of milk, curd and also, bus fares.

facts.claim: The Janata Dal(S) demands that the State government immediately roll back the increase in the prices of milk, curd and bus fares to ensure affordability for daily commuters and households.
facts.quote: The Janata Dal(S) demands that the State government immediately roll back the increase in the prices of milk, curd and bus fares to ensure affordability for daily commuters and households,

facts.claim: Addressing the gathering, the party leaders said that the State is reeling under severe drought following a prolonged dry spell and rainfall deficit, leaving farmers with heavy crop losses.
